info.name: Numark NV (BiteDJ Pi4 Controls Test v0.5.7)
info.author: Hidetsugu Takahashi; BiteDJ test mapping contributors
info.description: Original NV: adjustable scratch rotation, VU/peak test and existing absolute platter, pitch and layer fixes. Enable only on NV Control. LCD bridge uses NV Audio/Graphics MIDI separately. See README.

option.label: Scratch rotation multiplier
option.description: 1 = v0.5.1 rotation; 2 = twice the movement, including slow scratching. Nominal resolution remains 5600 counts per turn until physically measured.

option.label: Follow channel faders
option.description: Dark at the bottom; otherwise estimate the level after the fader. Red indicates the engine's pre-fader clipping flag.

option.label: Seven-second lamp test on mapping startup
option.description: Send VU values 0,1,2,3,4,5,0 for one second each without changing audio. The red value 5 needs hardware confirmation.
